columns.name: dataset
columns.description: Dataset name. Most studies have one dataset; a few have two.

columns.name: experiment
columns.description: Experiment within the dataset, usually one design or one source file. Labels follow the authors' files, not always the paper's experiment numbers.

columns.name: study
columns.description: Study name: first author, year and journal of the paper.

columns.name: subject
columns.description: One sequence of trials from one participant, coded within this dataset.

columns.name: person
columns.description: One participant, coded within this dataset. A person can have more than one sequence, for example two runs.

columns.name: id_type
columns.description: Kind of identifier the authors used for participants. The identifiers themselves are not included.

columns.name: person_link
columns.description: How sure it is that one person code is one human: verified (platform identifier or documented link), assumed_unique, or unknown (the same human may appear under more than one code).

columns.name: group
columns.description: Between-participant condition, in the authors' naming. Empty for single-group experiments.

columns.name: prior_exposure
columns.description: true if the participant had done an earlier perturbation experiment, including another study in OpenMotor; false if the paper excluded such participants; otherwise unknown.

columns.name: subject_excluded_by_authors
columns.description: The original analysis excluded this whole sequence.

columns.name: subject_exclusion_reason
columns.description: Why the authors excluded the sequence. Empty unless excluded.

columns.name: learner
columns.description: The paper's learner classification, for papers that make one. Empty otherwise.

columns.name: age
columns.description: Age in years.

columns.name: sex
columns.description: Sex or gender as reported.

columns.name: handedness
columns.description: Handedness.

columns.name: visual_acuity_logmar
columns.description: Visual acuity.

columns.name: medication_state
columns.description: Medication state at testing, for clinical groups.

columns.name: device
columns.values: mouse, trackpad, touchscreen, tablet, robot, kinarm, other, mouse_or_trackpad, unknown
columns.description: Input device. tablet means a digitizing tablet; mouse_or_trackpad when the paper does not say which.

columns.name: setting
columns.description: Tested online or in the lab.

columns.name: population
columns.values: healthy, parkinsons, cerebellar_degeneration, low_vision, deafferented, unknown
columns.description: Sample population. Healthy older adults count as healthy.

columns.name: trial
columns.description: Trial number within the sequence, from 0, counting every trial in order across sessions, including practice, no-feedback, probe and placeholder trials.

columns.name: trial_orig
columns.description: The authors' own trial number. It may restart at a new session, and is empty when the authors' files are ordered by position only.

columns.name: session
columns.description: Visit number within the sequence, from 0.

columns.name: block
columns.description: The authors' block label.

columns.name: phase
columns.values: practice, baseline, learning, aftereffect, washout, relearning, probe, transfer, other
columns.description: Standardized phase of the block.

columns.name: trial_kind
columns.values: reach, proprio_probe, aim_report_only, other, demo, missing
columns.description: reach; proprio_probe (the hand was moved passively, no reach); aim_report_only; demo (an instructed demonstration reach); missing (a placeholder row for a gap in the authors' trial numbers, with no data); other.

columns.name: break_before
columns.description: A documented pause came before this trial: the first trial, a new session, a rest break or an instruction screen.

columns.name: time_s
columns.description: Target onset time since the first trial of the sequence.

columns.name: gap_before_s
columns.description: Time from the end of the previous trial to this trial's target onset.

columns.name: target_angle
columns.description: Direction of the target, the instructed goal of the movement. 0 points right and angles increase counter-clockwise.

columns.name: target_id
columns.description: Target location within the experiment, one per direction and distance.

columns.name: stimulus_angle
columns.description: Direction of the displayed stimulus when it differs from the goal, for example when people reach opposite the stimulus.

columns.name: target_size_deg
columns.description: Angular radius of the target at the target distance.

columns.name: target_distance_norm
columns.description: Target distance divided by the largest target distance in the experiment.

columns.name: target_visible_during_move
columns.description: False if the target disappeared when the movement started.

columns.name: display_scale
columns.description: Display size relative to the experiment's reference display (1 = reference).

columns.name: target_event
columns.description: What the target did after movement onset.

columns.name: target_jump
columns.description: How far the target jumped after movement onset; 0 for none and flicker.

columns.name: jump_time_ms
columns.description: Time of the target event after movement onset.

columns.name: probe_kind
columns.description: Proprioceptive probe: active_post_reach (felt hand reported after the participant's own reach), or passive_robot and passive_experimenter (the hand was moved for them).

columns.name: probe_location_deg
columns.description: On passive probes, where the hand was moved to.

columns.name: instr_goal
columns.description: What participants were told to bring to the target: the cursor, the hand, or the hand at an instructed angle.

columns.name: goal_angle_deg
columns.description: Instructed hand direction relative to the target, when instr_goal is hand_to_angle.

columns.name: instr_strategy
columns.values: allowed, forbidden, maintain, remove, given_with_angle, unspecified
columns.description: Instruction about aiming: allowed; forbidden (for example, ignore the cursor); maintain; remove (stop aiming and reach straight to the target); given_with_angle (told where to aim); unspecified.

columns.name: strategy_angle_deg
columns.description: Instructed aiming direction relative to the target, when instr_strategy is given_with_angle.

columns.name: instr_disclosure
columns.description: What participants were told about the perturbation: nothing, that there is one, or exactly what it is.

columns.name: instr_report
columns.description: Report collected on the trial: an aim report, the felt hand position after a reach, or after a passive movement.

columns.name: aim_report_timing
columns.description: Whether the aim report came before or after the reach.

columns.name: cue_elements
columns.description: Contextual cues present before the movement, joined with | (for example light|tone or target_color:red).

columns.name: cue_onset_to_go_ms
columns.description: Time from cue onset to the go signal.

columns.name: prep_time_lo_ms
columns.description: Lower bound of a forced preparation-time window.

columns.name: prep_time_hi_ms
columns.description: Upper bound of a forced preparation-time window.

columns.name: target_to_go_ms
columns.description: Time from target onset to the go signal.

columns.name: fb_cued
columns.description: Participants knew before moving whether a cursor would be shown, from a blocked design or an explicit cue.

columns.name: hand_used
columns.description: Hand that moved, or that was moved on passive probes.

columns.name: hand_angle
columns.description: Direction of the hand relative to the target, counter-clockwise positive, from the earliest reliable measure the authors recorded (see hand_measure).

columns.name: hand_angle_fb
columns.description: Hand direction that determined the cursor, for example the endpoint at the target distance.

columns.name: hand_measure
columns.description: How hand_angle was measured. Constant within an experiment.

columns.name: hand_extent
columns.description: Movement extent in units of the target distance.

columns.name: rt_ms
columns.description: Reaction time.

columns.name: mt_ms
columns.description: Movement time.

columns.name: aim_report
columns.description: Reported aiming direction relative to the target.

columns.name: hand_report
columns.description: Reported felt hand position relative to the target. On passive probes, the proprioceptive error.

columns.name: excluded_by_authors
columns.description: The original analysis excluded this trial. Also true on placeholder rows.

columns.name: fb_visible
columns.description: What was shown: no cursor, a cursor during the movement, or the cursor only at or after the end of the movement (including delayed feedback).

columns.name: fb_mode
columns.values: none, veridical, rotated, clamped, mirror, gain, other, unknown
columns.description: How the cursor related to the hand.

columns.name: fb_form
columns.description: Form of the feedback.

columns.name: online_cursor
columns.description: What the cursor did during the movement.

columns.name: fb_endpoint_transform_only
columns.description: A veridical cursor during the movement was followed by a transformed endpoint.

columns.name: rotation
columns.description: Visuomotor rotation in force: cursor = hand_angle_fb + rotation. 0 on veridical trials.

columns.name: clamp
columns.description: Cursor direction relative to the target on error-clamp trials, 0 degree clamps included.

columns.name: mirror_axis_deg
columns.description: Mirror axis on mirror trials.

columns.name: gain
columns.description: Extent gain on gain trials: cursor extent = gain x hand extent.

columns.name: translation_xy
columns.description: Endpoint shift dx,dy in units of the target distance, on other-mapping trials.

columns.name: fb_spread_deg
columns.description: Spread of a cloud or blurred cursor at the target distance.

columns.name: n_cursors
columns.description: Number of cursors, when more than one was shown.

columns.name: cursor_error
columns.description: Where the cursor ended up relative to the original target, as the participant saw it. Empty when no cursor was shown.

columns.name: cursor_extent_error
columns.description: Cursor extent minus the target distance, in target-distance units.

columns.name: fb_delay_ms
columns.description: Delay of the feedback after the end of the movement; 0 if immediate.

columns.name: fb_duration_ms
columns.description: How long the feedback stayed on screen.

columns.name: outcome_channels
columns.description: Outcome signals shown on the trial, joined with | (cursor, hit_color, points, reward_tone, symbolic_error).

columns.name: reward
columns.description: Reward delivered on the trial. Empty if the task had none.

columns.name: score
columns.description: Number shown to the participant: points, or a signed error.

columns.name: score_max
columns.description: Maximum possible score.

columns.name: reward_space
columns.description: Whether the reward rule was applied to the cursor or to the hand.

columns.name: reward_center_deg
columns.description: Center of the rewarded zone relative to the target.

columns.name: reward_halfwidth_deg
columns.description: Half-width of the rewarded zone.

columns.name: hit
columns.description: The cursor hit the target.

columns.name: speed_warning
columns.description: A too-slow or too-fast message was shown.

columns.name: other_warning
columns.description: Another warning was shown, for example too far.
